registerDescription: Save your discoveries and join the community.
forgotDescription: Enter your account email and, if it exists, we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotSent: If an account with that email exists, we sent you a link to reset your password.
forgotGoogleNote: If you created your account with Google, sign in with Google; you don't need a password.
resetDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long.
resetInvalidDescription: Request a new link to reset your password.
resetSuccess: Your password was updated. Sign in with the new one.
resetEmailIntro: We received a request to reset your account password. To choose a new one, use this link:
resetEmailExpiry: The link expires in 30 minutes and can only be used once.
resetEmailIgnore: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email; your current password still works.
verifyEmailDescription: Confirm your email to activate your account verification.
verifyEmailSuccess: Your email is verified. You can now recover your account if you forget your password.
verifyEmailInvalidDescription: Request a new verification email or sign in to resend it.
verifyEmailBannerDescription: Verify your email to secure account recovery.
verifyEmailResent: We sent you a new email. Check your inbox.
verifyEmailCheckEmailDescription: We sent you a link to verify your email. Check your inbox.
verifyEmailIntro: Confirm your email to complete your account registration. Use this link:
verifyEmailExpiry: The link expires in 24 hours and can only be used once.
verifyEmailIgnore: If you didn't create this account, you can ignore this email.
